data.one_liner: Drop-in replacements for Flutter's Divider and VerticalDivider supporting multiple line styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides StyledDivider and StyledVerticalDivider widgets that mimic the standard Flutter dividers while adding support for solid, dotted, dashed, and dash-dotted lines. They seamlessly integrate with the ambient DividerTheme and ThemeData.
use_when: You need dotted, dashed, or dash-dotted divider lines in your Flutter UI.
You want drop-in replacements for standard Divider and VerticalDivider widgets that respect theme settings.
avoid_when: You only require standard solid dividers that are fully covered by Flutter's built-in Divider widget.
You need highly customized custom-painted divider paths beyond the four built-in line styles.
strengths: Drop-in replacements for standard Flutter divider widgets
Supports multiple line styles including dotted, dashed, and dash-dotted
weaknesses: Defaults differ slightly from Material 3 built-in dividers requiring explicit thickness or color adjustments to match
Limited to only four predefined line styles
